title: Twikey: Senior Java Developer
description_review: Senior remote backend developer role at Ghent-based fintech Twikey focusing on core platform development, architecture optimization, and scalable backend systems. The role involves close collaboration with the CTO and development team to build secure, high-performance systems. Direct ownership of platform evolution in a fast-paced fintech environment.
pros: Direct match for core Senior Java backend profile with architecture focus
Fintech domain aligns with 7+ years banking experience at ICBC and BBVA
Platform ownership and scalable backend design match senior engineering capabilities
cons: Does not explicitly specify Spring Boot version or applied AI/orchestration technologies

title: Proxify AB: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js)
description_review: Senior backend developer position requiring 5+ years of Node.js and 3+ years of Nest.js for building modern scalable web APIs and microservices. Long-term full-time remote role restricted to candidates located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours). Requires strong TypeScript, REST/GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, and event-driven architecture.
pros: Senior backend scope involving microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture
Matches secondary skills in TypeScript, Docker, and relational/NoSQL databases
cons: Primary requirement of 5+ years Node.js and Nest.js conflicts with Java/Spring core focus
Strict CET (+/- 3 hours) timezone restriction may limit location eligibility

title: Reddit: Backend Engineer, IAM
description_review: Remote US-based backend engineer position on Reddit's Identity and Access Management team. The role focuses on designing and building mission-critical, high-scale authentication and authorization systems serving millions of daily users. Involves high-leverage architectural execution and cross-functional collaboration across engineering.
pros: Authentication, authorization, and IAM domain aligns with OAuth2, JWT, and security experience
High-throughput distributed backend architecture fits senior systems engineering profile
cons: Specific backend programming language stack is not detailed in the description
Remote eligibility indicates US workforce focus

title: Abnormal: Director of Security Engineering
description_review: Remote US director-level engineering leadership role reporting directly to the CISO at AI cybersecurity firm Abnormal. The position entails leading and growing security engineering teams, managing FedRAMP cloud environments, and representing security to executive leaders and auditors. Demands people management and governance over hands-on application development.
pros: Enterprise architecture scope within an AI-driven cybersecurity platform
cons: Executive Director/people-management role is a mismatch for a hands-on Senior SWE profile
Requires extensive CISO-level security governance and FedRAMP compliance expertise rather than software engineering

title: Dremio: Software Engineer - Query Execution
description_review: Remote Portugal software engineering role on Dremio's Query Execution team building the core engine for lakehouse analytics. Involves developing query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, and runtime scheduling at scale using Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow. Focuses on low-level analytical systems performance for enterprise customers.
pros: Enterprise data lakehouse platform handling large-scale distributed performance and architecture
Deep technical focus on software quality, performance optimization, and reliable system components
cons: Focuses on internal query runtime and database engine mechanics rather than enterprise business microservices/REST APIs
Listed as remote within Portugal, which may impose regional residency constraints
